notes.title: Chests, City, Clicker v1.0.8
notes.content:
Hi!

I've been working on a major improvement to the game and here we are with version 1.0.8! Although the list of changes is not large, there is much more going on in the game.

Added:
- Junkyard, a building that generates nuts (new currency) every certain amount of time, depending on the level of development of the building
- Vehicles that can be bought and upgraded with nuts. Vehicles generate various rewards every certain amount of time, depending on their level
- Boost cards to speed up time without spending star cards
- The power plant is a new building
- Four characters related to the power plant

Changes:
- The options window has been enlarged
- Increased the building limit to 2000
- The system of receiving characters from quests has been reworked, now you get them much more often

Fixes:
- Daily rewards did not have a window animation
- When the build time was less than a second, the game did not change the bar to automatic

notes.title: Chests, City, Clicker v1.0.7
notes.content:
Hi!

The new version of the game introduces daily rewards, as well as several bug fixes and changes.

Added:
- Daily rewards, every 24 hours from the last claim, you will be able to get another one, and so on!
- Scaling of quest rewards, from now on, quests rewards will scale
- 4 achievements

Changes:
- Stats and achievements are now in one window
- Achievements are added automatically, after that you can collect the reward for getting them, not like before that collecting the reward gave an achievement
- Building upgrade quest scaling has been reduced, from now on less will be required to complete the goal
- You can own 1000 of each building, this is a limitation that will change the gameplay. This number will increase with each major update

Fixes:
- Trades didn't show correct data and didn't work (v1.0.6 broke trading)
- Card icons in the shop were not updating
- Sometimes the helicopter got stuck on the edge of the screen
- In the character/building upgrade window, the text did not fit in the window at higher values
- When selecting a card in the store, the bar was sometimes filled incorrectly

notes.title: Chests, City, Clicker v1.0.6
notes.content:
Hi!

The new version mainly fixes some bugs, but also adds something new - windows animations.
The exact changes to v1.0.6 are below.

Added:
- Windows animations, the game definitely suffered from lack of any animations, so I added a simple show/hide animation.

Fixes:
- Free chest timer didn't decrease when player was offline - it should.
- When a player tried to upgrade a building, the popup showed incorrect information.
- After reaching the maximum level of the building and restarting the game, the building disappeared.
